sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Private Investment Holding for High-Net-Worth Family Assets

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–Germany Double Taxation Agreement (in force, as amended by the 2015 Protocol)
France–China Bilateral Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (in force)
France–Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (in force)
France–Luxembourg Double Taxation Convention (in force, as amended in 2006)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-58 and R.561-1 to R.561-65; Code de commerce, Articles L.123-11-2, R.123-102 and R.123-166; Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016 and Décret n° 2017-1104 du 24 juin 2017 (French beneficial ownership register or RBE); EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843 as implemented in France.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and status certificate of the ultimate corporate shareholder (extrait du registre des sociétés étranger)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Commercial Registrar/Companies House of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Hague Convention; if home jurisdiction is not a party, consular legalization by the French Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney for the French incorporation agent and first manager (Gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent authority in the UBO/shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or French consular legalization, followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity and address verification of each beneficial owner (certified passport copies and proof of address)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public, private banker, or accredited certifier in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification and apostille/legalization; certified French translation included

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified declaration of good standing and absence of disqualification for the proposed Gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial records registry or notary in the Gérant's home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus certified French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Under Articles L.561-2 and L.561-5 of the French Monetary and Financial Code, all French intermediaries and the SARL itself must verify the identity of the client and its beneficial owners before formation and before opening any private-banking relationship. Mandatory screening must be run against: (i) the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists; (ii) EU consolidated financial sanctions; (iii) OFAC SDN/SSI and non-SDN lists for US-dollar wire and correspondent-bank compliance; and (iv) French national asset-freezing decrees issued by the Ministry of Economy. PEP identification is required for each UBO, director, and manager, including family members and close associates, using a qualified PEP database refreshed at least annually. Enhanced Due Diligence applies to the Medium_Risk_Enhanced single-family-office classification, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation. Any unusual transactions, anomalies, or UBO inconsistencies must be reported to TRACFIN, the French Financial Intelligence Unit, under Article L.561-15 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet des entreprises (INPI-operated single portal at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); underlying RCS filing with the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce; pre-filing availability checks on Infogreffe and INPI databases.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French is the mandatory language of all statutory filings and corporate deeds under the loi Toubon (Law n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994). A non-French company name must be transliterated into Latin script, must be available in the RCS, and must be accompanied in formal deeds by the French legal form suffix 'SARL'. If the name is translated into French for commercial use, the French version must be used consistently to avoid third-party confusion.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law provides no treasury-style name reservation; priority is fixed by the RCS filing date. If the Greffier issues an observation or rejection, the applicant must cure the identified defect within 30 days. A refusal can be challenged by filing a petition (requête) before the President of the Tribunal de commerce within one month under Article R.123-102 of the Code de commerce. If the refusal is grounded in a prior conflicting trademark or company name, the applicant may institute trademark opposition or invalidation proceedings before INPI/the Tribunal judiciaire or obtain a written coexistence agreement. No ordinary extension of the 30-day response window exists; a subsequent refiling creates a new priority date.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a SARL under Articles L.123-11-2 and R.123-166 of the Code de commerce through a licensed domiciliation agent, provided a domiciliation contract is executed and a French commercial address is maintained. For a single-family office that does not hold third-party funds, a virtual office is generally accepted by the registry and by private banks upon enhanced due diligence. However, the French tax administration will disregard an artificial domiciliation in determining the place of effective management under Article 209 CGI, so genuine substance and board decision-making records remain essential for French tax residency.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 10% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection for a non-regulated single-family office using a professional domiciliation address. The likelihood rises to approximately 30% if the French tax administration opens a tax audit and exercises the right of visit and seizure under Article L.16B of the Livre des procédures fiscales.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS incorporation filing and greffe tax (immatriculation au Registre du commerce et des sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce via the Guichet des entreprises
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory tariff fixed by the French Ministry of Justice (tarif des greffiers); approximately €78–€110.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of the constitution notice in a Journal d'annonces légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; €170–€250 per publication depending on the department.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SARL articles of association, manager appointment, and UBO clauses by French counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Avocat or registered corporate law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a standard SARL with one to two non-resident beneficial owners, including AML/KYC co-ordination.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translations of foreign incorporation certificate, apostilled passports, POA, and good-standing documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory translator tariffs and market benchmark; estimated for three to five documents.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization fees in the UBO's home jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / competent consulate / notary in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular and notarial fee schedule; average €350–€550 depending on jurisdiction and apostille volume.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Approved domiciliation company or law firm providing office address
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; €100–€180 per month prepaid annually.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced Due Diligence, PEP/sanctions database screening, and UBO compliance file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider / independent compliance firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for Medium_Risk_Enhanced classification, including real-time sanctions list monitoring and source-of-wealth review.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Private-banking account structuring and bank KYC onboarding arrangement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; sometimes waived upon deposit or relationship terms, but reserved here for pre-incorporation documentation and compliance review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-36 governing SARLs; Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. governing the Trade and Companies Register and the National Business Register; Law No. 2019-486 of 22 May 2019 on the business-formality single window.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI); registration data are transmitted to the competent commercial court registry and recorded in the Registre national des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of business-formality creation through the INPI Guichet unique, including the SARL articles of association and beneficial-owner declaration; the former paper M0 form is no longer the standard filing instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum SARL capital is required; capital may legally be set at EUR 1. For cash contributions, at least 20% of subscribed capital must be paid upon incorporation and the balance within five years of registration. Cash must generally be deposited with an authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts institution before finalization of the articles, with a deposit certificate attached to the formation file. Official registry, beneficial-owner, publication, and professional-adviser charges are separate and variable; no single statutory filing fee is denominated in USD.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Company has no statutory board; the following is a first shareholders’ and management resolution. The shareholders approve the final articles of association, subscribe for the entire issued capital in the proportions recorded in the subscription schedule, and confirm payment of the legally required initial cash portion. The registered office is established at [full French address]. [Name] is appointed gérant for an unlimited term, subject to the articles and applicable law. The gérant is authorized to open the corporate bank account, complete the INPI filing, make the beneficial-owner declaration, publish the legal notice, and execute all ancillary incorporation documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique for filing; competent commercial court registry for commercial registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the activity is limited to proprietary family-asset holding and does not include portfolio management for third parties, investment advice, payment services, deposit-taking, insurance distribution, or other regulated financial services. Verify shareholder identity, non-resident ownership, French registered office, capital amount, management powers, and ultimate beneficial owners. Obtain certified translations where documents are not in French.
required_dossiers: Shareholder passports or national identity documents
Corporate shareholder extracts and constitutional documents, if applicable
Business activity description and ISIC classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistencies before submission; obtain updated registry extracts, legalized documents, or certified French translations where requested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations for capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Sign the articles of association and subscription schedule. Deposit at least 20% of cash contributions into a blocked account in the company being formed, or with another legally permitted depositary. Obtain the certificate of deposit. Record any in-kind contribution in the articles and obtain a commissaire aux apports report unless a statutory exemption applies.
required_dossiers: In-kind contribution valuation report or exemption decision, if relevant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Remedy rejected deposits by correcting the company name, subscriber details, or payment amount; obtain a replacement deposit certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales authorized for the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an incorporation notice in French to an authorized legal-announcement publication service. Ensure the notice states the company name, form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, manager identity, and relevant registration information. Retain the publication certificate or notice attestation for the INPI filing.
required_dossiers: Final articles or approved incorporation particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Republish a corrected notice if mandatory particulars are omitted or inconsistent with the articles; attach the corrected certificate to the filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Electronic Registration and Beneficial-Owner Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic filing, upload the signed articles, publication certificate, capital deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, manager declaration, identity documents, and beneficial-owner declaration. Pay applicable registry and beneficial-owner charges shown by the portal. Monitor the filing dashboard and respond electronically to requests from the registry.
required_dossiers: Manager declaration of non-conviction and filiation
Corporate shareholder documents and powers of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond within the stated deadline to an INPI or commercial-court query, replace defective documents, correct the activity description, and resubmit the incomplete portion without changing the filing date where the portal permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Registration Evidence and Activate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent commercial court registry and INPI National Business Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the SIREN/SIRET identifiers, Kbis extract or equivalent registration evidence, and confirmation of beneficial-owner filing. Request release of blocked capital to the corporate bank account after registration. Maintain statutory registers, accounting records, annual accounts, manager decisions, shareholder decisions, and changes in ownership or management.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request registry correction for clerical errors; file amendments through the INPI Guichet unique for changes to the manager, registered office, purpose, capital, shareholders, or beneficial owners.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None for a passive single-family investment holding company carrying on proprietary investment activity only. The Autorité des marchés financiers and Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution become relevant if the business undertakes regulated investment, banking, payment, insurance, or portfolio-management activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or industrial operating permit is required for the stated activity. A separate AMF or ACPR authorization, registration, or notification may be required if the actual business extends beyond proprietary holding and investment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, implemented locally through the departmental prefecture and the regional Directorate for Environment, Planning and Housing (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for a passive investment holding office with no industrial installation, manufacturing, storage, or material environmental impact. An environmental authorization or declaration may apply if the premises or operations constitute an Installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement or otherwise fall within applicable environmental nomenclature.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No sector-specific industrial wastewater or VOC threshold applies to ordinary office activity. Any discharge, hazardous-waste handling, emissions, or regulated storage must comply with the French Environmental Code, applicable ICPE requirements, wastewater permits, waste-tracking obligations, and prefectural conditions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No industrial clearance is required for ordinary office premises. The operator must comply with French Labour Code workplace-health and safety duties, fire-prevention and evacuation requirements, accessibility rules, electrical and equipment inspections, and applicable Établissement recevant du public requirements. Structural-load certification, fire-safety notices, or municipal authorization may be required for construction, fit-out, change of use, or public access.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP). Official professional portals: impots.gouv.fr for income and VAT filing; Chorus Pro (chorus-pro.gouv.fr) for electronic invoicing and B2B/B2G tele-payment; formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr for corporate formalities and business registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing a registered SARL must obtain a SIRET number and intra-Community VAT number through the Online Formalities portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). The greffe of the competent Commercial Court forwards the registration dossier to DGFiP, which allocates the French tax ID and VAT number. Foreign entities without a permanent establishment in France but that engage in taxable supplies in France must request direct VAT registration via DGFiP using CERFA Form No. 15959, attaching evidence of economic activity, a local business agent where required, and relevant incorporation documents. The procuration must also appoint a tax representative in France if the entity is established outside the EU.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The French SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). Eligible small and family-owned SARLs may elect, under Article 239 bis AA of the French General Tax Code (Code général des impôts, CGI), to be taxed as pass-through entities at the level of shareholders for up to five consecutive years. Groups qualifying for déficits of a tax resident parent may elect fiscal integration (régime d'intégration fiscale). French law also contains hybrid mismatch election carve-outs under EU ATAD rules: taxpayers may elect to align accounting/fiscal years and use a French substantive tax provision to neutralize mismatches across recognized lines. No other general check-the-box regime applies in metropolitan France.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT / TVA (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: ETF for services: EUR 36,800 annual turnover; ETF for goods: EUR 91,900 annual turnover (franchise en base de TVA). Establishments in France engaged in taxable activities must register for VAT even below these thresholds if they dispatch goods subject to excise or perform certain cross-border services. For a single-family office operating as a private investment holding, management services rendered by the SARL will ordinarily be subject to the service threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates a phased e-invoicing reform for all B2B transactions. As of 1 September 2026, all domestic B2B issuers must be able to receive electronic invoices through either a certified Partenaire de Dématérialisation (PDP) or the public portal Chorus Pro. From 1 September 2027, all businesses must issue e-invoices and transmit e-reporting transaction data (previously GOV). Invoices must be issued in the structured standard Factur-X/UDL or XML synchronous with the API, with mandatory digital signatures for cross-border clearance. No real-time per-transaction tax stamping or identical fiscal stamping is currently required within metropolitan France, but full machine-readable transmission to DGFiP is compulsory. Accountants must retain the FEC (Fichier des Écritures Comptables) audit trail and continuous control data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: To claim 0% VAT on exports of goods to destinations outside the European Union, the taxpayer must prove that the goods were physically shipped outside the EU under customs-validated export statements (Article 262-I of the CGI). Intra-Community supplies to VAT-registered customers in other EU Member States are also exempt when the supplier holds the customer's valid EU VAT number and submits a recapitulative statement (DEB). For offshore services, zero-rating applies when the customer belongs outside the EU and the services fall under article 259-b (e.g., transfers of intellectual property, consultancy, data processing, financial services, and similar services provided to non-established persons) or are directly linked to export trading of goods. A single-family office providing investment supervision, wealth planning or administrative services to non-resident beneficiaries must document the non-EU status of the recipient and the location of effective use/economic enjoyment to justify the 0% rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane – DAN)
Bill of Lading or equivalent contract of carriage
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration may reassess VAT for export transactions lacking robust documentary proof, applying 80% of the evaded tax as a deliberate misstatement penalty (manquement délibéré) or 100% if fraudulent intention is established. Unsupported zero-rating is treated as an undeclared domestic sale, triggering immediate VAT collection plus interest at 0.20% per month, and possible discretionary fine under Article 1737 CGI of EUR 5,000 per rectified document. Fraud committed in the context of export zero-rating can constitute the criminal offence of fiscal fraud under Article 1741 CGI, punishable by up to EUR 500,000 fines and five years' imprisonment. Retrospective clawback extends to all VAT deductions claimed on purchases underlying the fraudulent exports, and the administration may freeze assets through criminal proceedings (avoirs en débit).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full convertibility for both capital and current accounts under EU single market rules and post-1990 liberalization. Profit remittances, dividends, and interest payments face no restrictions once corporate tax is settled and beneficial ownership is verified. Hurdles are limited to CRS/FATCA reporting to French tax authorities and potential EU anti-avoidance directives.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion ratio applies to export receipts. Receipts are freely convertible into EUR. Companies must file customs declarations via Douane for statistical purposes and report all transactions exceeding €10,000 to banks for AML monitoring. Repatriation occurs immediately upon receipt.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium viability for offshore digital EMIs under PSD2; constrained by French AML and banking regulations requiring local entity or licensed partnerships. Full cross-border digital services limited without French compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding with video KYC is permitted for French SARL directors and beneficial owners when supported by verified company registration documents. Physical presence may be required for non-resident individuals or enhanced due diligence cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial ownership chains or undisclosed principals
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner declarations, corporate structure chart, identification documents, source of funds evidence, and tax residency proofs
Detailed transaction narratives, legal opinions on ownership, and third-party verification reports

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing via SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes 'CAP' for capital or 'EQTY' for equity. Verification through Banque de France reporting thresholds, supported by ownership proofs, bank references, and incorporation documents.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing via SWIFT MT103 or Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for trade settlements. Use of TARGET2 for euro clearing. Trade finance requires specific purpose codes and supporting documents for export/import compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and annexed reports (comptes annuels) filed with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (registry of the local commercial court)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within six months of fiscal year-end; filing with registry within one month of approval and no later than seven months after year-end (extendable by court order)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 4,000; court may force filing under astreinte; late filing can prevent the entity from producing accounts and may lead to administrative strike-off or compulsory liquidation after repeated defaults.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultats – Cerfa 2065)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP – French Tax Administration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal period, due by the 3rd business day after 1 May; for off-calendar year-end, due within 3 months of the closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers 5% penalty on tax due, monthly late-payment interest (0.20% per month), and potential additional 10% surcharge for failure to respond to formal notice; wilful fraud may bring criminal fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial ownership (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe (Trade and Companies Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership; annual re-confirmation at the annual accounts filing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to declare beneficial ownership is fined up to EUR 7,500 for a legal person; false declarations carry criminal penalties (imprisonment up to six months and fine up to EUR 30,000).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting minutes (délibération d'approbation des comptes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate records (kept at registered office; no direct filing obligation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be held and minuted within six months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold or approve in due time prevents lawful dividend distribution; directors incur civil liability for losses; serious default may allow shareholders to petition the court for a mandatory meeting or dissolution of the entity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit applies to a SARL if it exceeds any two of: balance-sheet total above EUR 4 million; net turnover excluding VAT above EUR 8 million; and more than 50 employees, at the end of the fiscal year. An audit is also required when shareholders representing at least 10% of capital demand one, when the SARL holds a major participation in another company exceeding certain thresholds, or when the entity is part of a consolidated group that is itself subject to joint audit obligations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, CRC/ANC Regulation 2014-03, as updated), including provisions of the French Commercial Code; IFRS is not required for SARL individual statutory accounts except for consolidated accounts of certain groups (not applicable to a standalone SFO).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The beneficial-owner declaration is made on the RCS registration and must be updated within 30 days of any change in direct or indirect shareholding. For complete transfers, the notice of transfer is reported in the registre des mouvements de titres. At each annual accounts filing, the legal representative confirms the beneficial-owner information is unchanged; the declaration is also re-submitted whenever a change occurs. Failure to do so blocks registration and creates penalties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des décisions des associés (shareholders' decisions register)
Registre des mouvements de titres (share transfer register)
Registre de présence et de délibérations du gérant (manager's attendance and deliberation minutes)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 8,000 per year when audit is required; not required below the mandatory thresholds
